base: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: FOUR-FRAME character-action sprite sheet for an Ember RPG NPC. Image1 supplies the chosen new character identity. Images2-5 are the EXISTING Cliente Suspeito action sequence: use them as references for gesture animation clarity, realistic painterly style, full-body framing and transparent cutout presentation ONLY, not for character identity. Output ONE PNG with EXACTLY FOUR full-body instances of the same new character in TWO COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, four equal portrait cells, reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. A substantial clearly visible four-frame PROP INTERACTION sequence, comparable to the reference's lift-cup/drink/return: not breathing, not walking, not duplicate poses. Feet stay planted in the same position and baseline in every cell. Same consistent camera, clothing, face, proportions, scale, and equipment. Natural anatomy and hands. Character occupies 88% of each cell height with clean margins, all objects fully inside their respective cell, no overlaps across the grid. Suggested overall canvas 1024x1536. Make a clean sprite CUTOUT on transparent alpha: completely remove the identity image's haze or gradient, outside silhouettes must be invisible alpha zero. No scenery, floor, shadow, glow, vignette, grey/brown/black/white background, checkerboard, text, labels or grid lines. Transparent output is crucial, foreground opaque. This exact four-frame action:
actions: Cartographer: frame1 holds the folded map low with compass near waist; frame2 opens the map chest-high with both hands; frame3 head turns and one arm extends compass outward to check direction; frame4 holds the unfolded map angled outward in one hand and points to a route on it with the compass hand.

Forager: frame1 holds mushroom near basket; frame2 raises mushroom to eye level to inspect it; frame3 leans forward and sniffs mushroom with wrinkled nose; frame4 drops mushroom into basket while lifting a second mushroom to chest height with the other hand, smiling.

Bell collector: frame1 holds a small hanging bell at chest level; frame2 lifts the bell toward his ear; frame3 shakes the bell with an obvious wrist tilt and listens intently; frame4 holds bell outward at shoulder height and presses free index finger to lips.

Moth keeper: frame1 cradles cage low with both hands; frame2 raises cage chest-high; frame3 lifts cage lid slightly and peers inside while a moth remains perched on rim; frame4 holds cage chest-high on one forearm with free hand raised gently toward the perched moth.

Charcoal burner: frame1 shovel upright and sack low; frame2 plants shovel and brings free hand toward his forehead; frame3 visibly wipes brow with forearm; frame4 rests shovel diagonally against shoulder and extends free hand palm-up inspecting soot.

Tinker: frame1 holds kettle low; frame2 raises kettle to eye level; frame3 tilts kettle and taps its side with small tool held in other hand; frame4 holds tilted kettle chest-high and raises tool hand in a satisfied thumbs-up gesture.

Marsh trapper: frame1 holds coiled snare in both hands at belt; frame2 pulls cord loop wide at chest level; frame3 lifts the snare loop and examines its knot; frame4 holds tightened snare loop out toward viewer at shoulder height, free hand pulling cord taut.

Rat catcher: frame1 holds empty rat trap cage low; frame2 lifts cage chest-high; frame3 opens cage latch and peers suspiciously inside; frame4 holds trap sideways chest-high and points with free hand to its open latch.

Masked physician: frame1 holds bundle of herbs waist-high; frame2 raises herbs toward the beak mask; frame3 uses free gloved hand to turn and examine a small glass vial in front of his eyes; frame4 holds vial overhead toward light and keeps herb bundle against chest.

Scholar: frame1 holds closed book in left arm; frame2 opens book with both hands chest-high; frame3 peers into book, mouth open, free right hand raised in a clearly visible argumentative gesture; frame4 tucks book under left arm and points accusingly down with fully extended right arm.

Ferryman: frame1 holds pole upright; frame2 shifts both hands up pole and leans slightly to brace it; frame3 pulls pole toward chest with obvious arm motion and looks over his shoulder; frame4 braces pole diagonally across body with widely separated hands and turns head toward viewer.

Courier: frame1 holds wax-sealed letter low near dispatch bag; frame2 raises letter chest-high and studies seal; frame3 opens satchel flap with other hand and tucks letter inside; frame4 keeps satchel flap open with one hand and points outward with the other arm while looking along that direction.
scholarFourthFrame: Keeps book open in left hand and adjusts spectacles with right hand; original first three frames retained.
